description.en: Search pinned Kaggle solution archives and source-backed decision cards offline, and generate five-role research task packets for historical competition scenarios. Includes a native Harness tool bundle; training and submissions remain with the selected competition workflow.
description.zh: 离线检索固定版本的 Kaggle 解法档案与有出处的方法卡，并为真实历史比赛场景生成五角色研究任务包。提供原生 Harness 工具 bundle；训练与提交沿用已有比赛工作流。
